affected.note: Maximum of about 53.23 million records that may have leaked, including duplicates; Sagawa says it does not represent the number of individuals. Covers waybill data for parcels from 2026-06-21 to 2026-09-30, freight contract customer lists and Smart Club member data. Handwritten waybills, credit card data and passwords are not included.

summary.en: Sagawa Express confirmed unauthorized access by a third party to its online parcel inquiry service on 2026-09-30. It reported that up to about 53.23 million records (including duplicates) of sender and recipient names, addresses and phone numbers, plus some customer and member data, may have leaked.
summary.ja: 佐川急便は2026年9月30日、Webサイトの「お荷物問い合わせサービス」への第三者による不正アクセスを確認した。送り状データの依頼主・届け先の氏名、住所、電話番号や一部の顧客・会員情報について、重複を含め最大約5,323万件が流出した可能性があると公表した。
